newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Jan-Aug budget gap down 9 pct y/y - BoS.
newsitem.headline: Spain Jan-Aug budget gap down 9 pct y/y - BoS.

text.p: The Spanish budget deficit in January-August was down nine percent against the same period last year, according to a Bank of Spain report.
The report was delivered to the economic committee of parliament on Wednesday, a bank spokesman said.
The report said this narrowing of the deficit shows "the continuing correction of the budget disequilibrium."
In July, the accumulated budget deficit was 1.2 trillion pesetas.
